text_block_list.text:
It's time for training, but I don't see a
trace of Fuji
Kiseki—that is, until she
nearly runs into me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ack! Sorry, didn't mean to scare you! I'm
kind of
in a hurry!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
One of my residents has a fever, and I've
been
looking after her!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I need to get this medicine to her ASAP!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: At least you're not playing hooky for fun...

text_block_list.text:
We have training today! I completely
forgot!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I've been so preoccupied with
taking
care of my resident that it slipped
my mind...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I have to be better than this. I'll be more
careful
next time, promise!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
